_comment: What is up for auction. Read once at startup by listings.py; see the
Each listing: title, url, and optionally blurb, note, sold, photos.
The first photo is the hero, shown large; the rest go in a grid under it.
Every photo needs alt text - the page is almost entirely images.
No end times in `note` on purpose: eBay is the authority on when a lot
closes, changing one here costs a deploy, and a stale 'ends Tuesday' is
the kind of claim that is worse than no claim at all.
Photos live in static/auction/ and must be in the repository, since that
is how install.sh gets them onto the container. STRIP THE EXIF: phone
pictures taken at home carry GPS.

listings.title: Strangers Prints No. 0
listings.blurb: Australia drawn in ASCII, Neruda in full Spanish, a Bobby Tables joke, and a message telling whoever reads it that no feeling is final.

photos.alt: A dark wood picture frame filled with about a hundred thermal receipts, each headed INCOMING with a timestamp, arranged in columns.
Detail of the top-left: receipts showing a message about brighter days, an ASCII map of Australia, a drawing of a girl with a mug, and a Bobby Tables SQL-injection joke.
photos.caption: Top left. The one about brighter days came from someone who signed off only as "someone on the internet".

photos.alt: Detail of the lower right, showing dithered pixel-art receipts including a rabbit, a footballer and several ASCII drawings.
photos.caption: Lower right. Braille art gets decoded back into a bitmap and printed as a picture, which is why these are dots and not characters.

photos.alt: The frame held up at an angle in a living room, with a second smaller framed collage visible behind it.
photos.caption: For scale.

listings.title: Strangers Prints No. 1
listings.blurb: A shark, a troll face, a goose insisting peace was never an option, and somebody politely trying to talk the printer out of its own instructions. Also the receipt asking for picture support, which is why the front page now explains how to send one.

photos.alt: A dark frame of thermal receipts held up in a living room. Among them a shark, a lion outline, a troll face, a British guard, a QR code, and a goose captioned PEACE WAS NEVER AN OPTION.

listings.title: Strangers Prints No. 2
listings.blurb: The Trojan Room coffee pot explained at length, Jabberwocky in full, a marinade recipe, and hellos from the Netherlands, Sweden, Portugal and Turkey.

photos.alt: A dark frame of thermal receipts held up indoors. Among them the Berserk brand symbol, a winged cat, dense blocks of text including Jabberwocky, and a figure with a rocket launcher.

listings.title: Strangers Prints No. 3
listings.blurb: HELP in hollow letters, a panda, an Among Us crewmate, a fighter jet, and a skull that claims it can smell you.

photos.alt: A dark frame of thermal receipts held up indoors. Among them the word HELP in outline, a panda, Squidward, an Among Us crewmate, a fighter jet and several QR codes.
